grindless.machine.steam_vein_drill.toolt: Drills the vein marked by the vein sample, over and over. It never runs dry.
Up to 4 runs at once, one drill bit per run (the bits wear out by chance).
Needs 1 steam hatch, 1 steam input bus and 2 steam output buses.
grindless.machine.steam_greenhouse.toolt: Grows trees, rubber trees and crops with a sapling or seed that is never used up.
Up to 4 runs at once. No planting, no felling.
Needs 1 steam hatch, 1 steam input bus and 1 or 2 steam output buses.
tooltip.grindless.bronze_drill_bit: Wears out by chance in the Steam Vein Drill (about 10% of the runs). Veins below Y 0 need steel.
tooltip.grindless.steel_drill_bit: Wears out by chance in the Steam Vein Drill (about 4% of the runs) and brings up 50% more ore.
tooltip.grindless.empty_vein_probe: Craft it with two raw ores of a vein to make a vein sample.
tooltip.grindless.vein_sample: Put it in the input bus of the Steam Vein Drill to drill this vein. It is never used up.
tooltip.grindless.vein_sample.steel_only: Deep vein: it needs a steel drill bit.
